_comment: VibeCoded Orchestrator — VS Code tasks template. Belt-and-braces companion to the Claude Code SessionStart hook: starts vct-hub when the project folder is opened in VS Code, even when no Claude Code session has been launched yet. Both invocations are idempotent (vct-hub --start-if-not-running exits 0 whether the hub just started, was already running, or could not start). Bypass with VCT_DISABLE_HOOKS=1 in your environment.

tasks.label: Start VCT Hub
tasks.detail: Idempotently start vct-hub on folder open (v0.2.21+).
